Report

Where drafts are stored

Drafts are written to JSON files by the store, which the editor reads at start.

Decided 2026-10-09: drafts are stored in SQLite

The reviewer chose SQLite over JSON files: one file, transactions.

Design

The editor reads drafts from the store at start. The sync job reads drafts from the store too. The store keeps drafts in JSON files, one per draft, and writes each draft to one of the JSON files on save.
